crops.feature: lamp cluster, right as seen head-on
crops.reading: One figure-of-eight (peanut) bezel: a yellow-painted plate ring with 8 screws, outlined by a thin black line. Small LED lamp inboard and lower (lit white, about 24 LEDs), large clear headlamp outboard and higher (unlit, scuffed). No separate lamp. Panel's outer bottom corner a large radius into navy.
crops.reading2: One peanut bezel (~8 screws, thin dark outline) with two lenses: smaller LED lamp inboard and lower, lit white; larger unlit lens outboard and higher. Panel's lower outer corner a large radius (~1/6 of crop) into the dark body.

crops.feature: lamp cluster, left as seen head-on
crops.reading: Mirror of the right: large headlamp outboard and higher (lit, warm white), small LED lamp inboard and lower (unlit, dimpled grey), one peanut bezel, 8 screws. No separate lamp.
crops.reading2: Mirror layout: large lens outboard and higher, lit; small lens inboard and lower, unlit, dotted texture; same peanut bezel with ~8 screws.

crops.feature: right windscreen and its surround, wiper
crops.reading: Tall pane in a black frame, orange line along the top, frame top-outer corner rounded (~0.07 m), bottom corners near square. A black bar with screws across the bottom of the frame (wiper/washer rail). Wiper: two parallel arms from two pivot bosses low near the screen's middle, parked up-left towards the gangway.
crops.reading2: Dark rectangular opening, slightly rounded corners, thick black surround, orange line along the top; wiper pivots at bottom centre-right, arms rest diagonally up-left; black mounting strip across the bottom, yellow below.

crops.feature: left windscreen and its surround, wiper, destination display
crops.reading: Left screen: same black-framed pane; the destination display (amber LED, two rows) sits at the top of the glass, inboard half; wiper mirrored (pivot low near the middle, parked up-right towards the gangway). The face corner is a pale sunlit curve outside the frame.
crops.reading2: Destination display just under the top of the glass, two rows of orange LED text; wiper pivots bottom right and rises to the right, mirror of the right one; black bracket row at the bottom, yellow strip below.

crops.reading: Dark rectangle about 3:1 with amber dot-matrix text in two rows, square corners, inside the left screen's glass at its top.
crops.reading2: Wide dark rectangle (~3:1), orange LED text in two rows, square-ish edges, inside the windscreen.

crops.reading: Yellow gangway door, two leaves with a centre seam and two studded hinge strips (at ~0.20 and ~0.77 across), two small recessed handles at ~2.2 m. A thin light-blue seal round the door. Frame dark charcoal, weathered silver on its right (its side face, seen from the right), rails ~0.1 m wide; frame top a separate cap piece with large rounded corners (~0.14 m). The door outline narrows towards the top (the face leans back above the screens' bottom).
crops.reading2: Yellow double door with centre seam, hinge strips at ~1/4 and 3/4, two recessed handles at ~60% height; tapering, wider at the bottom; thick dark frame (~1/6 width each side, thicker right with silver scuffs), light-blue seal inside; frame top corners rounded (~1/6 width).

crops.feature: yellow over the windscreens (cap), orange line, dome
crops.reading: Yellow cap over both screens and round the top of the gangway frame; its top edge curves down from ~3.58 m near the centre to the orange line at the outer corner, where the orange line turns up the corner towards the cantrail. Navy D-shaped dome on the centre with a lit oval marker. 'Danger overhead live wires' labels either side.
crops.reading2: Yellow band across both screens and above the gangway, navy dome above; D-shaped dome with lit oval marker; orange line along the bottom of the yellow, angled up at the outer corners; labels each side; gangway frame top with big rounded corners.

crops.reading: Navy dome, flat bottom on the cap, semicircular-ish top, holding a pale oval marker (~40% of its width), lit.
crops.reading2: D-shaped dark navy bump, flat bottom, half-oval top, thin yellow line under it; pale oval marker lamp, lit, ~40% of the dome width.

crops.feature: yellow panel under the right screen, number, outer corner
crops.reading: Yellow panel from the black bar under the screen down to just below the bezel; number '375 803' in blue across its top; outer bottom corner a large radius (~0.2 m), outer top square; inner edge runs behind the gangway frame.
crops.reading2: Squarish yellow panel, blue '375 803' near the top, lamp cluster lower right, outer lower corner a large radius (~1/5 of panel width), top-right square.

crops.reading: '375 803' in a medium-blue sans-serif, digits ~0.10 m tall, a space between the groups.
Navy valance in two bulged halves either side of a dark arched recess; Dellner coupler head (two round openings) on a roller box in the recess; valance bottom ~0.24 m.
crops.reading2: Dark lower front, two bulged valance sections, central arched recess with a Dellner-style coupler (two round holes) and a roller below.

crops.feature: face edge into the near bodyside
crops.reading: The face turns into the bodyside round a large-radius vertical corner (grey with reflections); the yellow panel stops short of the corner; navy beyond.
crops.reading2: Face edge a big smooth rounded curve into the bodyside; yellow panel at lower left stops before the curve; corner radius ~1/4 of crop width.

crops.reading: 375713 (375/7): peanut bezel each side PLUS a separate small round lamp further inboard and lower, outside the bezel (3 lamps per side). Number blue. Destination on the left screen. Otherwise the 375/8 face.
crops.reading2: 3 round items per side: peanut pair (small lower-inboard, large higher-outboard) plus a separate small dark round lamp further inboard; number blue; destination lit on the left screen.

crops.reading: 375/7: separate small round lamp inboard (unlit, dark), then the peanut: small lamp lit warm white, large headlamp outboard-higher.
crops.reading2: Three round items: separate small dark lamp inboard; small lit amber lens lower-middle; large grey lens outboard-higher; the latter two share a peanut ring.

crops.reading: 375805 (375/8): peanut bezel only, 2 lamps per side; headlamp lit on the left, small LED lit white on the right; number blue.
crops.reading2: Peanut bezel each side, 2 lamps, no separate tail lamp; number blue; destination on left screen.

crops.reading: 375706 (375/7): peanut bezel plus a separate round red tail lamp inboard, lit red both sides (3 lamps per side). Number blue.
crops.reading2: Each side a peanut with two unlit lenses plus a separate round red tail lamp inboard, lit; 3 lamps per side; number blue.

crops.reading: 375821 (375/8): peanut only; the small inboard-lower lamp lit red as the tail. No third lamp.
crops.reading2: Each side: peanut with bigger grey lens outboard-higher and smaller inboard-lower lens lit red; no separate third lamp.

crops.feature: lamp cluster, right as seen head-on, 375908 (375/9)
crops.reading: 375908 (375/9): peanut only, small lamp inboard-lower lit red, large head outboard-higher.

crops.feature: lamp cluster, left as seen head-on, 375908 (375/9)
crops.reading: 375908: mirror, peanut only, red tail lit inboard.
375613 (375/6): 3 lamps: separate small round lamp inboard (no bezel), then the peanut with small lit lamp and large headlamp outboard-higher. Note only (not rendered).
crops.reading2: 3 lamps: small dark round hole inboard (no bezel), small lit lens lower-middle in the bezel, large lens outboard and highest; brass-coloured peanut bezel.

crops.reading: 375607 (375/6): separate red tail lamp inboard (lit), then the peanut pair. Note only.
crops.reading2: 3 lamps: round red lit lens inboard without bezel; small grey lens lower-middle and larger lens outboard-higher in a slim peanut outline.

crops.feature: gangway frame from the side: depth, bellows
crops.reading: Gangway frame seen from the side: a deep box, depth roughly 1/4-1/3 of its width (~0.3-0.45 m), rounded top; grey pleated bellows behind it, then the yellow face.
crops.reading2: Frame a deep box, visible depth ~1/4-1/3 of its width, rounded top corner; white/grey concertina bellows behind it.

crops.reading: Navy cab door (no cyan) with a tall droplight split by a transom, two vertical slots below, a handle recess low at the rear; seams both sides, orange line just above.
crops.reading2: Navy cab door with a tall narrow window split ~40% down, warning sticker above, two vertical slits and a handle recess below; no yellow or cyan.

crops.feature: first saloon window bay (cab door to first door)
crops.reading: First saloon bay between the cab door and door 1: one long black-framed glazed opening with an inner frame (glazing unit), corners lightly rounded, navy pillars either end.
crops.reading2: Single large dark pane (~4:3) with an inset rectangle at the top, slightly rounded corners, navy frame; cyan door leaf at the left edge, navy pillar at the right.

crops.reading: Two cyan leaves, full height from the orange line to the step; each leaf a tall narrow black window; leaf edges curve in at the bottom with the tumblehome; no other colour on the leaves.
crops.reading2: Two cyan leaves, full height, each with a tall narrow dark window (~1/6 of door width, 60% of height); bottoms taper inward.

crops.feature: cab corner: face edge, cab side ahead of the cab door
crops.reading: Cab corner of 375814: the yellow panel ends at the face edge; the navy cab side has no yellow; the orange line wraps the corner.
crops.reading2: Reader read it as the face head-on: yellow cap, screen, '375 814' in blue, headlamp plus red tail in one ring; navy-yellow boundary curved. Settled on s-corner-814 itself: it is the face corner seen obliquely, the reader's description of the face agrees.

crops.feature: rear car end of the cab car and second door
crops.reading: Rear end of the cab car: navy, rounded car-end corner, the second door near it; no maroon or other band on the cab car's rear end.
crops.reading2: Curved navy car-end bulge between cars, cyan door at the edge, orange stripe along the roofline; no maroon.

crops.reading: Leading bogie under the cab car, black frame, two axles, no skirt.
Roof navy-grey (wet, reflecting the sky), orange cantrail line with a thin navy line above it, roof pods over the doorways.
Side-on (2015 white livery): cab door with a tall two-pane droplight (transom ~55% down), two slots below; thick dark seams front and rear (the front one ~0.09 m), door top at the orange line.
crops.reading2: White door, tall narrow window in a thick dark frame with a mid bar, warning triangle above, two slits below, thick dark edges.

crops.feature: fixed cab side window ahead of the cab door
crops.reading: Fixed cab side window just ahead of the cab door: black surround, rounded on its front corners, straight against the door seam at the rear; light glazing inset.
crops.reading2: Dark rounded-corner trapezoid frame, lighter inset ~55% width, front corners rounded (~1/6 of crop), rear straight against the pillar.

crops.feature: first saloon window bay and mullion
crops.reading: First bay: one long glazed band in a thin black frame with one mullion ~30% from the front, near-square corners.
crops.reading2: Wide window ~2.3:1, thin dark frame, one mullion at ~30% from the left, near-square corners.

crops.reading: Front edge of door 1 (yellow in 2015) right after the bay window's rear pillar.
Nose from the side: the face curves back at the top into the roof, a protruding lower valance with a round hole, small fixed window ahead of the cab door.
crops.reading2: White nose curving back at the top, fixed window at upper right, round cap and latch panel, rounded skirt with a hole.

crops.reading: Leading bogie from the side (blurred).

Car 2 (behind the cab car), its end next to the cab car: maroon from the orange line down to the window top, from just inside the car end back over door 1 (covering the top of both door leaves above their windows), plus a thin maroon strip under the first window; the rest navy, door leaves cyan below the maroon.
crops.reading2: Maroon above the windows from the door to near the car end, full height from the stripe to the window top, covering the top ~1/4 of the door leaves; thin maroon line under the window; cyan door below.

crops.reading: 375/6: same maroon frame on car 2's cab-car end: band above the windows and over the door-leaf tops, thin strip under the window, stops square before the car end's curve.
crops.reading2: Same as 802: band from the orange line to the window top, over the top of both door leaves, thin strip under the window; ends square before the end pillar.

crops.feature: cab car side, whole, from above
crops.reading: Whole cab car from above: cab door, one bay, door 1, four-pane bay, door 2, one bay; all navy except the cyan door leaves and the orange cantrail line.
crops.reading2: Cab at right; 2 double-leaf cyan doors plus the cab door; 2-pane group, 4-pane run, 2-pane group; navy body, orange stripe along the top.

crops.feature: car 2 front end: maroon panel, other side
crops.reading: The other side of the train (375805 leading): the same maroon band at car 2's end next to the cab car, over the door-leaf tops.
crops.reading2: Maroon patch above the window from the door's edge to the car end curve, door leaves maroon at the top; no maroon below the window visible here.

crops.reading: Door 1 of 375713: two cyan leaves, tall narrow windows, full height.
crops.reading2: Two cyan/teal leaves with tall narrow dark panels, handle and warning icon; bottoms taper inward.

crops.feature: diagram: cab end, cab door, first door
crops.reading: Class466cuxton diagram (old white livery): cab door and first door positions: a pixel copy of the 377 Unisouth drawing (door at 440-586 px vs 442-586).
Refurb diagram: car 2 carries a maroon (#7F0037) outline round its first window bay from the car end over door 1.
crops.reading2: Maroon band above the windows from the left end to the door, including above the door, thin maroon band under the windows.

crops.reading: Refurb diagram: car 3 carries a yellow (#FFD800) outline round its first bay (first class, 2019); not on 2025 photos (p802, p629: car 3 plain navy).
crops.reading2: Yellow band above the left window group from the end to the door, over the door top, thin yellow under the window.

crops.feature: cab corner, cab door and first passenger door (three-quarter)
crops.reading: 375713 three-quarter: face corner, navy cab side with a small fixed window, cab door with a droplight, one window bay, then the first cyan door; the orange cantrail line runs over both doors.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, cab car, right side
crops.reading: Right side between door 1 and door 2, just under the window bottom: lower-case 'southeastern' in a condensed sans, 'south' white and 'eastern' light blue, reading normally (so 'south' is the front half on this side). Nothing else on the panel.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, cab car, left side
crops.reading: Left side, same place under the window bottom between doors 1 and 2: 'south' white, 'eastern' light blue, reading normally, so 'south' is the rear half on this side. Same artwork, not mirrored.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, next car, left side
crops.reading: Next car, left side: a small white-then-blue mark under the window bottom about 3 m behind door 1, the same place the wordmark sits on the cab car. Blurred (22 px wide) and crossed by a platform reflection, but white leads blue as on the cab car.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, next car, left side
crops.reading: 375622 next car, left side: the same small white-and-blue wordmark under the window, behind door 1 (the maroon first-class bay is ahead of the door). Confirms the next car carries it.
Face: yellow panels with the unit number, warning label and lamps only; no operator logo or wordmark on the face.
